skill.name: inkroom
skill.description: Generate, edit, and upscale images through InkRoom with cost previews, batch workflows, and original-image recovery. Public model discovery needs no token; media operations require your own InkRoom account and token.
skill.summary: Create images through InkRoom, preview costs, and recover original results without submitting another generation request.
skill.author: inkroom-ai

security_audit.summary: All 114 static findings are false positives in the reviewed source, including JavaScript literals, regular expressions, image validation, and multilingual documentation. Network requests and token access support the declared InkRoom workflow, with endpoint restrictions and credential-free media downloads. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized credential exfiltration, or concealed executable payloads; live service behavior was not verified.

content.user_title: Create and Recover Images with InkRoom
content.value_statement: Image workflows need clear cost estimates and reliable recovery after interrupted downloads. InkRoom connects image creation, editing, and upscaling with preview receipts and original-image recovery.
actual_capabilities: Discover public models, sales prices, and service capabilities without an InkRoom token.
Call InkRoom generation, reference-image editing, upscaling, and batch tools using live tool schemas.
Preview expected or maximum points before execution and continue using the original request or batch receipt.
Save request records, raw responses, and media manifests with image identities, SHA-256 hashes, dimensions, and local paths.
Resume existing image tasks through wait_images and checkpoints without automatically submitting another generation request.
Download original images with two workers, bounded retries, public-address checks, and strong ETag-based partial download recovery.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and a client with terminal access; the bundled scripts use Node.js built-in modules.
Media operations require your own InkRoom account, token, network access, and sufficient points.
The bundled validator supports PNG, JPEG, and WebP but requires host image decoding before confirming complete delivery.
Recovery depends on server retention and link expiration; the client cannot extend expired links or guarantee regeneration.

use_cases.title: Preview Poster Production
use_cases.description: Prepare a portrait event poster, inspect the selected model and estimated points, and authorize production under the account policy.

use_cases.title: Compare Product Lighting
use_cases.description: Create three lighting variants from a supplied product image while preserving its appearance and reviewing the batch quote.

use_cases.title: Recover Interrupted Deliveries
use_cases.description: Continue an existing image task from a saved response or checkpoint, then verify original counts, manifests, and host decoding.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Available Models
prompt_templates.prompt: List the public InkRoom image models and capabilities. Show available sales prices without authorizing an account or generating images.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect public options without spending points.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview one portrait coffee poster with warm lighting in InkRoom. Show the model and maximum points, then wait for my approval before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: review a single-image quote before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Product Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my supplied product photo for three lighting variants. Preserve the product appearance, preview one batch, and wait for my approval before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a reference-based batch with explicit cost approval.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and Verify Originals
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume my saved InkRoom checkpoint in the same output directory. Do not regenerate. Verify image identities, original counts, hashes, actual settlement, and host decoding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover interrupted work and verify delivery.

output: Requested: one portrait coffee poster with warm lighting.
Model and maximum points: awaiting the live InkRoom preview.

output_examples.input: Continue an existing task and stop after the configured polling limit.
output: Recovery reached the polling limit while continuation remained pending.
A saved checkpoint is available for the next recovery attempt.
No new generation request was submitted.
Complete delivery remains unconfirmed until originals are saved and decoded by the host.

best_practices: Review the live preview, respect confirmation requirements, and reuse its original receipt for execution.
Provide tokens through standard input or secure environment injection, and use a private state directory.
Keep responses and checkpoints, recover the existing task, and decode saved originals before reporting complete delivery.
anti_patterns: Submitting another paid generation request because an image download failed or a response was truncated.
Placing tokens in command arguments, conversation replies, shared outputs, or unrelated image-host uploads.
Treating thumbnails, matching hashes, successful receipts, or container checks as proof that every original image is fully decoded.

faq.question: Do I need a token to explore models?
faq.answer: No. Public models, capabilities, tool discovery, and permitted public prompt reads support anonymous access. Media operations and private information require your own token.

faq.question: Does the skill require additional packages?
faq.answer: No third-party packages are required. The scripts use Node.js 18 or newer with built-in modules and require terminal access.

faq.question: Is image generation free?
faq.answer: The skill package is free. Media operations consume InkRoom points according to live pricing; previews show estimated or maximum costs.

faq.question: How is my token handled?
faq.answer: Authorization reads your token through standard input and stores it with owner-only permissions. An injected INKROOM_MCP_TOKEN takes precedence and is not persisted.

faq.question: Can I recover an interrupted image task?
faq.answer: Yes. Resume uses an existing response or checkpoint and only continues wait_images. Recover saves media from recorded responses without submitting generation.

faq.question: Does a saved image mean delivery is complete?
faq.answer: No. The scripts validate containers, dimensions, and hashes, but the host must decode originals. Server expiration can also limit recovery.
